pr_title: [Fix #52304] Avoid computing `klass` if reflection is a `belongs_to` in `ActiveRecord::AutosaveAssociation#inverse_belongs_to_association_for`
pr_body:

### Motivation / Background

<!--
Describe why this Pull Request needs to be merged. What bug have you fixed? What feature have you added? Why is it important?
If you are fixing a specific issue, include "Fixes #ISSUE" (replace with the issue number, remove the quotes) and the issue will be linked to this PR.
-->

Fixes https://github.com/rails/rails/issues/52304
Ref: https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/49847

### Detail

Adds a condition in `ActiveRecord::AutosaveAssociation#inverse_belongs_to_association_for` to return early if the current reflection is a `belongs_to`, as the inverse can't possibly be a `belongs_to` as well. This then ensures that polymorphic `belongs_to` reflections don't have their class computed which raises an error like the one in the linked issue (see https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/31895 for why this happens).

An alternative fix, specifically for the linked issue is to simply return if `reflection.polymorphic?`, but imo what I've currently got is better since it handles non-polymorphic cases as well, and will short circuit in all cases where the inverse logic is not applicable.

**Edit:** Some more context in https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/52305#issuecomment-2222227506

So you'd need to add a `Certificate` model and a `Sponsor` model.

> 
> So you'd need to add a `Certificate` model and a `Sponsor` model.

All good, I've added some failing tests similar to the ones I added in https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/49847.

It turns out this is only an issue if the validate association callbacks are run (either through `validate: true` like you did or autosave which I'm doing with `accepts_nested_attributes_for`) **AND** `:inverse_of` is set on the polymorphic `belongs_to` association.

Without the `inverse_of` the class seems to compute just fine. Might be something to look into separately but I'm gonna consider it out of scope for this since the condition I added is a good one to have anyway.

issue_context.title: "Polymorphic associations do not support computing the class." error when creating a record with a `has_one :through`
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce

This is a regression between `7-2-stable` and `main`.


```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "bundler/inline"

gemfile(true) do
  source "https://rubygems.org"

  # Gem passes:
  # gem "rails", "7.1.3.4"

  # 7.2 passes:
  # gem "rails", github: "rails/rails", branch: "7-2-stable"

  # Edge fails:
  gem "rails", github: "rails/rails", branch: "main"

  gem "sqlite3", "~> 1.4"
end

require "active_record"
require "minitest/autorun"
require "logger"

# This connection will do for database-independent bug reports.
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "sqlite3", database: ":memory:")
ActiveRecord::Base.logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)

ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  create_table :sponsors, force: true do |t|
  end

  create_table :members, force: true do |t|
  end

  create_table :certificates, force: true do |t|
    t.integer :member_id
    t.integer :certificatable_id
    t.string :certificatable_type
  end
end

class Sponsor < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_one :certificate, as: :certificatable, validate: true
  has_one :member, through: :certificate
end

class Member < ActiveRecord::Base
end

class Certificate < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :member
  belongs_to :certificatable, polymorphic: true, validate: true, inverse_of: :certificate
end

class BugTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_association_stuff
    Sponsor.create!(member: Member.create!)
  end
end

```

### Expected behavior

Test should pass.

### Actual behavior

```
  1) Error:
BugTest#test_association_stuff:
ArgumentError: Polymorphic associations do not support computing the class.
    rails-69d904e60f78/activerecord/lib/active_record/reflection.rb:500:in `compute_class'
    rails-69d904e60f78/activerecord/lib/active_record/reflection.rb:439:in `_klass'
    rails-69d904e60f78/activerecord/lib/active_record/reflection.rb:431:in `klass'
    rails-69d904e60f78/activerecord/lib/active_record/reflection.rb:261:in `inverse_of'
    rails-69d904e60f78/activerecord/lib/active_record/autosave_association.rb:470:in `inverse_belongs_to_association_for'
    rails-69d904e60f78/activerecord/lib/active_record/autosave_association.rb:322:in `validate_single_association'
    rails-69d904e60f78/activerecord/lib/active_record/autosave_association.rb:228:in `block in define_autosave_validation_callbacks'
```

### System configuration
**Rails version**: `main`

**Ruby version**: 3.2
